create.name: Asha Nayaswami
create.bio:
Asha Nayaswami is a teacher in the Kriya Yoga lineage of Paramhansa Yogananda. As a twenty-two-year-old student at Stanford in 1969 she went to a talk by Swami Kriyananda, who had been a close disciple of Yogananda himself, and stayed close to him for the next forty-five years as student, assistant and in time a teacher herself. She was among the first residents of Ananda Village, the community he founded in the Sierra Nevada foothills of California, and since 1987 she has been a spiritual director of Ananda Palo Alto, helping to build its temple, schools, bookshop and meditation groups. In 2009 she took vows in Ananda's renunciate order, which is why she wears blue; her earlier books carry the name Asha Praver.

Her teaching is warm, frank and non-sectarian. She draws on the Bhagavad Gita and the Gospels side by side and applies them to ordinary problems of work, family and relationships. Most of her talks are free on YouTube, including long series on the Gita, Patanjali's Yoga Sutras and the chakras, and she leads Sunday services in Palo Alto that are streamed online. She has taught in more than two dozen countries. Her books include Lightbearer, a biography of Kriyananda drawn from decades of notes, and Ask Asha, a collection of answers to readers' questions.

books.title: Swami Kriyananda: Lightbearer: The Life and Legacy of a Disciple of Paramhansa Yogananda
books.author: Asha Nayaswami (Asha Praver)
books.description: A long first-hand biography of Swami Kriyananda, built from notes the author kept over more than four decades at his side. It follows his struggles and achievements and doubles as a history of the Ananda communities.

books.title: Ask Asha: Heartfelt Answers to Everyday Dilemmas on the Spiritual Path
books.author: Asha Praver (Asha Nayaswami)
books.description: Letters from readers about work, family, loss and faith, each answered with practical spiritual counsel in the Yogananda tradition. Short chapters make it easy to dip into.

books.title: Swami Kriyananda: As We Have Known Him
books.author: Asha Praver (Asha Nayaswami)
books.description: Around two hundred brief recollections from people who knew Kriyananda over forty years, gathered and arranged by the author. Together they give a picture of him as a teacher and friend.

courses.title: How Chakras Determine Your Destiny (Omega Institute)
courses.description: A five-night residential retreat at Omega in Rhinebeck that reads the chakras as a map of the habits and karmic patterns shaping a life. Talks are mixed with meditation, chanting, music and discussion, and no previous yoga experience is needed.

courses.title: Awakening Consciousness: Living From the Inside Out (Ananda Village)
courses.description: A weekend retreat at The Expanding Light, the guest retreat at Ananda Village in Northern California, with her talks, daily yoga and meditation, an evening of devotional music and a visit to the Crystal Hermitage. Rates include lodging and vegetarian meals.

courses.title: The World Needs Your Higher Self (Sivananda Ashram, Bahamas)
courses.description: A short guest programme she leads at the Sivananda yoga ashram on Paradise Island in the Bahamas. It runs within the ashram's yoga-vacation schedule of daily classes and satsang.
courses.price: Included in the ashram's Yoga Vacation Program room rates

courses.title: Lightbearer: The Life & Legacy of Swami Kriyananda (online series)
courses.description: Recordings of a chapter-by-chapter online series in which she tells the stories left out of her biography of Kriyananda, one year of their friendship per session. Live classes are paused; the recorded sessions can be joined at any time.

free_resources.title: Sunday Services with Asha
free_resources.description: Her Sunday talks from Ananda Palo Alto, collected on YouTube. Each applies a point from Yogananda's teaching to ordinary life.

free_resources.title: Demystifying Patanjali: The Yoga Sutras
free_resources.description: A free video series working through Patanjali's sutras in plain language, from the yamas and niyamas to meditation and samadhi.

free_resources.title: The Essence of the Bhagavad Gita
free_resources.description: A free class series on the Gita as read by Yogananda, taken chapter by chapter with practical examples.

free_resources.title: Chakras, Karma & Reincarnation
free_resources.description: A free video series on the subtle spine, the chakras and how karma and rebirth are understood in her tradition.

free_resources.title: Living Wisely, Living Well (podcast)
free_resources.description: Short daily podcast episodes in which she reads and reflects on a passage from Kriyananda's book of the same name. Hundreds of episodes are available.
